units.geometry: logical pixels (Flutter dp / browser CSS px at100% zoom)
units.typography: logical pixels; line heights are absolute logical pixels

token_reference_convention: color.* references resolve within the active light/dark theme in design_tokens.json; typography.fontFamily.preferred resolves to the bundled family when present, else the documented system stack.

global_rules.preferred_font: Whizpee Roboto (bundled Roboto400/500/700, Apache2); use exact font assets and weights. Inter is only a future optional font swap and is not the reference font.
global_rules.text_secondary_light: #5D6F65; legacy #728179 retained for decorative source compatibility, not required readable small text.
global_rules.shared_controls: Normalize legacy40px composer and emoji actions to44px accessible touch targets; visual glyphs keep20px sizing.
global_rules.text_scaling: All stated heights are minimums when text is involved. Allow growth/scrolling at larger text scale; keep navigation, submit, close and call end controls reachable.
global_rules.focus: 3px color.brand outline, 3px offset; never remove without replacement.
global_rules.pointer: Hover feedback uses 6% foreground overlay; pressed uses 12%.
global_rules.reduced_motion: Suppress decorative transforms/pulse; retain direct progress indication.
global_rules.state_ownership: Controlled widgets receive typed values/actions; shared session state survives route/pane changes.
global_rules.web_capabilities: Call history and visual review states remain; ordinary browser start/answer and video-compression functions unavailable.
global_rules.privacy: Business room identity derives from originating Story; private phone/avatar never substitute for public identity.
global_rules.specification_status: Normative handoff contract, including responsive refinements; not a claim that every original HTML pixel already matched these rules.

font_weights.mapping: Legacy550 maps to500; legacy600/650/750 map to700. Avoid synthetic semibold.
